wc:minerva-skeleton.summary: Loading placeholder (lines, avatar, title, paragraph, card).
wc:minerva-skeleton.description: Placeholder shapes shown while content loads (`<Skeleton>` of React). By default it is an announced busy region (`role="status"`, `aria-busy`, named "Loading"); once `loaded` is set it renders its slotted content instead. `decorative` renders one bare `aria-hidden` block, to compose custom layouts inside a container that already announces the busy state.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Shape of the placeholder

properties.name: animation
properties.description: Loading animation ("false" disables it)

properties.name: loaded
properties.description: Shows the slotted content instead of the placeholder (the React library's `loading={false}`)

properties.name: decorative
properties.description: Renders one bare decorative block (`aria-hidden`) instead of the busy region

properties.name: size
properties.description: Edge length of a decorative circular block (numbers are pixels; default 32)

properties.name: width
properties.description: Width of each line (numbers are pixels)

properties.name: height
properties.description: Height of each line (numbers are pixels)

properties.name: borderRadius
properties.description: Corner radius of each line (numbers are pixels)

properties.name: lines
properties.description: Number of lines

properties.name: avatar
properties.description: Shows an avatar placeholder

properties.name: avatarSize
properties.description: Avatar size (numbers are pixels)

properties.name: avatarShape
properties.description: Avatar shape

properties.name: active

properties.name: paragraph

wc:minerva-skeleton-text.description: A decorative block of text-line placeholders (`<SkeletonText>` of React); the last line is shortened to 70% unless `no-shrink-last` is set. Hidden from assistive technologies: expose the busy state on the surrounding container.

properties.name: noShrinkLast
properties.description: Keeps the last line at full width (the React library's `shrinkLast={false}`)

skeleton-text.title: SkeletonText
skeleton-text.description: 多行文本占位，最后一行缩短以更接近真实文本。

SkeletonProps.animation: 加载动画；"false" 关闭动画
SkeletonProps.width: 每行的宽度（数字单位为像素）
SkeletonProps.height: 每行的高度（数字单位为像素）
SkeletonProps.children: 真实内容，在 loading 为 false 时渲染
SkeletonProps.loading: 显示占位图形；设为 false 时渲染 children
SkeletonProps.style: 应用到每一行的内联样式
SkeletonProps.avatarSize: 头像尺寸（数字单位为像素）
SkeletonProps.active: 将 card 变体高亮为激活状态
SkeletonProps.paragraph: 显示段落占位（替代文本行）
SkeletonProps.title: 显示标题占位（替代文本行）
SkeletonProps.aria-label: 加载占位的无障碍名称（以 aria-busy 的 status 区域呈现）
SkeletonProps.ref: 根 <div> 元素的 ref；仅在加载中时挂载（否则直接渲染 children）
SkeletonProps.decorative: 只渲染单个装饰性占位（aria-hidden 的 span），而不是可被读屏播报的加载区域
SkeletonProps.size: 装饰性圆形占位的边长，优先于 width 和 height

SkeletonTextProps.gap: 行间距：间距刻度档位或任意 CSS 长度
SkeletonTextProps.shrinkLast: 将最后一行缩短到 70% 宽度
SkeletonTextProps.animation: 加载动画；"false" 表示关闭

cssVars.--skeleton-highlight-color: 移动高光的颜色（wave 动画）
cssVars.--skeleton-radius: 行与块的圆角（圆形保持圆形，矩形块保持直角）
cssVars.--skeleton-gap: 段落各行之间以及头像旁的间距
